air_paths.note: P21's 7.18 mm3 part-in-air is the released builder's own sliver at the cable-boss corners (r3.00 in the part, r3.10 in its air model), unchanged.

carriage_internal.checked: Every pair of carriage parts and fasteners (core, P20-P24, cable, Beacon, EBB42, all fasteners); earlier revisions checked only their changed parts against the rest.
carriage_internal.note: A face contact is a Boolean common under 0.01 mm thick: two faces that touch, such as a screw head bearing on the EBB42 board, not an interference.

note_conduit_on_x_beam.finding: In the Monolith gantry model, P21's conduit front face lies on the X beam's rear face (Y-33.20) and the probe cable runs 0.2 mm from it, over the whole X travel. The original accessory audit used an older gantry model with the beam's rear face at Y-32.70 (0.5 mm).
note_conduit_on_x_beam.study_note: P20, P21's conduit, P22's collar, riser and elbow and the cable riser moved rearward; P21's fairing underside raised to Z-27.0; P20's wing seats, P24 and P22's plenum stay put.

note_stack_anchor.finding: P24's two rear holes line up with the core's right case-clamp inserts in P02, but the core's own M3x35 case screws, fitted from the front, already fill them. No screw for P24 was ever specified and none can engage, so nothing screws P20, P21, P24 or the EBB42 to the carriage: the stack rests on P22's collar, against P02's rear face and under P02, located by P24's pockets over three core screw heads.
options: Core change note: separate anchor inserts in P02 for P24, or longer inserts shared by both screws.
Accessory option: two M2.5 screws from below in the column's chamfered rear corners, inside its outline (not adopted).
A rear foot on P21 screwed to a ledge on P22 was tried and rejected: at the stock rear limit it hits the rear motor mounts near X0 and X350.

frame_source.note: Nominal frame, panels and door from 01_Voron24_350_Frame_and_Enclosure as world bounding boxes (conservative for the extrusion profiles). No Z drives, bed supports or bed wiring are modeled.

hardware.changed: P20 to P21: 2x M3x8 ISO 7380 button-head screws (were socket heads) at X+-5.5, 1 mm forward, seated 1.6 mm down in P20's lugs, into the same 2x M3 x 3 mm (OD 4.5) inserts, which move with them in P21's top flange. Fit them before the EBB42: they sit under its board.
hardware.unchanged: Everything else, including P22, P24 and their screws.

limitations: Rigid CAD, sampled straight paths. Insert pull-out and printed-part creep are not qualified.
The two notes are measured on the user's nominal Monolith model; real extrusion and printed-joint tolerances decide whether the conduit actually rubs the beam.
